agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py: Token._get_repr_value had an inverted truncation condition (`if not (len(raw) > 7):`) that caused short repr values to be truncated and long ones to display in full, the opposite of intended behavior. Reverted to `if len(raw) > 7:`. This single helper is used by Token.__repr__, TokenList._pprint_tree, and indirectly by other repr/pprint paths, so this one-line fix resolves all 4 reported regressions (pprint, token repr, tokenlist repr, and the related 4th check). Verified manually via repr() and _pprint_tree() output on parsed SQL showing correct truncation behavior (e.g. 'select' shown in full, 'abcdefghij' truncated to 'abcdef...').
